runtime_lanes.label: Kain Semantics Lane
runtime_lanes.summary: Session truth, intent routing, resource/report registries, and authored DCC semantics stay in Kain.

runtime_lanes.label: Fabric Orchestration Lane
runtime_lanes.summary: Step ordering, dependency edges, reusable intent graphs, and report emission stay in Fabric.

runtime_lanes.label: Python Bootstrap Lane
runtime_lanes.summary: Project bootstrap, registry hydration, and tensor preflight stay in the Python seam.

runtime_lanes.label: GPU Compute Lane
runtime_lanes.summary: Preview bake, sculpt displacement, material packing, and compositor-style shader work stay on the GPU seam.

runtime_lanes.label: Native C ABI Lane
runtime_lanes.summary: Narrow helper seams like sculpt signatures and brush snapshots stay behind the C ABI bridge.

runtime_lanes.label: Rust Analysis Lane
runtime_lanes.summary: Graph analysis, topology health, and narrow helper logic stay in the Rust crate lane.

runtime_lanes.label: Node Bridge Lane
runtime_lanes.summary: Publishing, delivery, and host-adjacent bridge surfaces can round-trip through Node when Kain delegates the final bridge hop.
